name: Shone Complex

criteria.description: Presence of parachute mitral valve causing mitral inflow obstruction
Presence of subaortic stenosis or membranous subaortic obstruction
Coarctation of the aorta or other left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
Echocardiographic evidence of left-sided obstructive lesions

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of at least three of the four characteristic left-sided obstructive cardiac lesions including parachute mitral valve and supravalvular mitral ring
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on echocardiographic and clinical findings; genetic testing is not routinely diagnostic.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Parachute mitral valve causing mitral inflow obstruction
searchTerms: mitral valve with single papillary muscle
heart muscle hypertrophy on left side
failure to gain weight as baby
brain blood flow blockage due to clot

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart failure
Normal inflammatory markers unless endocarditis present
imaging: Echocardiography showing parachute mitral valve, supravalvular mitral ring, subaortic stenosis, and coarctation of the aorta
Cardiac MRI for detailed anatomical assessment
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly and pulmonary congestion
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; sporadic cases predominate
other: Cardiac catheterization may be used for hemodynamic assessment
Electrocardiogram showing left ventricular hypertrophy or arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: More severe hypoplasia of left heart structures
Usually incompatible with long-term survival without intervention
Absence of parachute mitral valve and supravalvular mitral ring
Isolated mitral valve involvement without associated left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
No supravalvular mitral ring or coarctation of the aorta

redFlags: Severe left ventricular outflow tract obstruction causing heart failure
Signs of systemic hypoperfusion or shock
references: Shone JD, Sellers RD, Anderson RC, Adams P Jr, Lillehei CW, Edwards JE. The developmental complex of 'parachute mitral valve,' supravalvular ring of left atrium, subaortic stenosis, and coarctation of aorta. Am J Cardiol. 1963 Jul;11:714-25.
Mavroudis C, Backer CL. Pediatric Cardiac Surgery. 4th ed. Wiley-Blackwell; 2013.
